title: Vendor Hosts
description: ADR-071 D5/D6. The single source of truth read by scripts/sandbox-policy-compile.sh. Declares the closed set of AI-vendor hosts the compiler is allowed to add/remove from sandbox.network.allowedDomains, plus each host's clearance for the 'sensitive' sensitivity level. Structural validation mirrored inside the compiler's embedded validator; this file documents the same shape and is the reviewable spec.

host.description: Lowercase, no scheme, no port, no glob. Unique across the array (T-level invariant, checked by the compiler and by tests/test-vendor-host-policy.sh).

is_runtime.description: True for exactly one host — the endpoint the session itself runs on (api.anthropic.com). Always allowed, at every sensitivity level.

cleared_at_sensitive.description: true REQUIRES a non-null reviewed_on and a non-empty terms_url (ADR-071 D5) -- a violation is treated as NOT cleared by the compiler and fails a CI hygiene test (T5).

reviewed_on.description: ISO 8601 date the clearance was recorded, or null if never reviewed.
